searchText: I am not too familiarized with the docs so, what is the values of n? Where it is defined? Is it possible that n=k? A mid ground would be restrict `n < (k*numBuckets)/2`, It would be not worldwide gossip and keeps specs as it is, only changes a constant. Also doing gossip in edge cases. oh just read that `n` is `interested`, I think it should be more clear, but the suggestion of limit `n<some value` still valid Clients are free to choose their n and k. Currently Trin uses k is all the nodes interested in the content in our routing table, n = 8. Where 4 of n are ``1. Closest `NUM_CLOSEST_NODES` ENRs are selected`` and 4 of n are ``2. Random `NUM_FARTHER_NODES` ENRs are selected from the rest`` thank you!
